title: DEPS Baseline v1 — Canonical Organizational Understanding Ownership Migration

sprint.name: Discovery 2 Phase 4C
sprint.scope: Canonical Organizational Understanding ownership migration with compatibility adapters and exact rollback.

evidence.claimBoundary: Authoritative Phase 4C classification, ownership, compatibility, replay, and rollback report.
Current deep architecture verification input; known findings remain separately reported.
Current benchmark-only research decision and explicit production-readiness limits.

scorecard.rationale: Canonical reusable Category A composition became active without claiming a numerical uplift.
The migration preserved existing downstream behavior and made no User Intelligence improvement claim.
The migration made no Collective Intelligence change or improvement claim.
Single truth ownership improved while authority, persistence, provenance, and disclosure boundaries remained unchanged.
The additive migration preserved deterministic replay, historical compatibility, and exact rollback.

architecture.observation: Canonical Organizational Understanding has one production composition owner.
Completed Explanations retain claims and ancestry; Organizational Understanding owns governed composition.
The explicit legacy path restores pre-migration Runtime and downstream bytes.
Category A ownership is active through an additive migration.
Historical records and existing consumers remain compatible.
Phase 4C ownership checks pass; unrelated pre-existing deep findings remain visible.

benchmarks.summary: The authoritative report records 14/14 migration scenarios passing.
The current capability audit records no structural registry failures.
Deep architecture findings remain visible and are not represented as a full pass.

researchObservations.observation: No research result was promoted by Phase 4C. Local Understanding Utility remains benchmark-only and the localized nonlinear adapter decision remains replicate.

introduced: One additive canonical composition field in existing Organizational Understanding state.
One bounded ownership mode for explicit rollback.
removed: Executive Assessment ownership of canonical reusable Organizational Understanding.
complexity.justification: The bounded additive surface establishes one canonical truth owner while retaining exact compatibility and rollback.

governanceObservations.observation: Truth ownership converged without changing authority, provenance, persistence, or disclosure semantics.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: Determinism, historical replay, additive persistence, downstream equivalence, and exact rollback are demonstrated.

regressions.observation: Pre-existing deep architecture findings remain; Phase 4C introduces no reported ownership-boundary regression.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: Phase 4C tested downstream equivalence, not a controlled user-capability outcome.
Phase 4C did not test governed multi-contributor or cross-scope outcomes.
The migration gate did not measure elapsed time, peak memory, or persisted-artifact growth.
The adapters are intentionally retained and no longitudinal maintenance protocol exists.

rollback.description: Use the explicit legacy ownership path to restore the prior composition behavior and downstream bytes.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept: canonical ownership improved, compatibility remained stable, no duplicate truth was introduced, and exact rollback was demonstrated.
